subject: Tiered annual token-commit proposal and SLA options
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@trillionbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tiered annual token-commit proposal and SLA options

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our discussion I attached a short proposal and a companion pricing sheet that lays out three annual commit tiers for the Hosted API: Starter, Growth, Enterprise. High level:

- Starter: 10M tokens/yr at $0.0008/token (baseline onboarding package)
- Growth: 100M tokens/yr at $0.00055/token (recommended for product-led scaling)
- Enterprise: 1B tokens/yr at $0.00038/token (best unit economics; includes priority support)

Key commercial points (short):
- Monthly true-up: consumption is measured monthly; commitments billed monthly against committed tokens with overage at a blended overage rate (sheet shows tiered overage bands).
- Flex slabs: ability to scale up mid-term; when commit increases by >=2x we apply an incremental rebate on the newly committed tokens.
- SLA choices: Hosted standard (99.9% regional SLO), Hosted Plus (99.95% + priority routing), Dedicated (SLA + dedicated capacity; separate pricing).
- Security/compliance: we can provide SOC 2 Type II evidence and an optional Data Processing Addendum.

Ask: please review the attached and tell me which tier you want us to price for signature (Starter/Growth/Enterprise) and whether you need Dedicated SLAs or Hosted Plus. If you pick Growth or Enterprise, I can request a one-time onboarding credit from finance.

If useful, I can put together a mutual action plan (timeline for PO/DocuSign/enablement) for procurement. Our preferred timeline to lock terms for calendar Q3 is end of month (31 Jul).

Attachments: 20260720-TrillionBank-proposal-v1.pdf (proposal), RBW-pricing-slabs-2026.xlsx (detailed table)

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0148
https://redwood.com
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@trillionbank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Tiered annual token-commit proposal and SLA options

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear proposal and the fast turnaround. A couple quick clarifying questions from procurement and engineering:

1) Overage mechanics: you call out a blended overage band in the sheet. Can you confirm the per-token overage at 10-20% over commit vs 20-50% vs >50%? Our finance team wants to understand the marginal price curve before we commit to Growth.
2) Monthly true-up: would you consider a quarterly true-up instead? Monthly true-up gives us variance headaches from a forecasting perspective.
3) SLA: we prefer Hosted Plus but need a firm latency SLO for the EU region as several of our services are multi-region. Is the 99.95% latency/availability measured per region?
4) Discounts: Growth looks promising but can you do a deeper discount (additional 8–10%) if we commit to a multi-year (2-year) arrangement?

Procurement (procurement@trillionbank.com) is copied. We may loop in our security reviewer for SOC 2 artifacts. Also — can you include a sample carve-out for data residency in the proposal?

Thanks,
Jordan
Head of Platform Partnerships | Trillion Bank
jordan.price@trillionbank.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@trillionbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 12:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tiered annual token-commit proposal and SLA options

Jordan —

Appreciate the rapid review. Answers below and notes on concessions we can offer: 

1) Overage marginal pricing (examples from the attached sheet):
- 0–10% over commit: billed at committed tier price + 25% (e.g., Growth committed price $0.00055 → overage $0.0006875)
- 10–50% over commit: billed at committed tier price + 40%
- >50% over commit: billed at a higher spot slab (sheet shows $0.0011/token)
We build those bands to encourage accurate forecasting but still allow bursty traffic.

2) Monthly vs quarterly true-up: we prefer monthly for alignment with usage telemetry and cost reporting, but will accept quarterly true-up for Growth or Enterprise if Trillion Bank signs a 12-month minimum and agrees to an explicit forecast cadence. We can model both — I'll attach a quarterly-trueup variant in an updated sheet if you prefer.

3) SLA regional specifics: Hosted Plus 99.95% is measured per-region (EU/US/APAC). For the EU region we guarantee 99.95% availability and an average 95th percentile generation latency under 450ms per token for typical batched requests (the SLA numbers in the proposal are scoped to public Hosted API; Dedicated offers tighter latency and regional isolation). We will add that regional wording to the proposal.

4) Multi-year discount: we can offer an additional 7.5% off the per-token list for a 2-year committed Growth plan (subject to finance approval). For Enterprise we can consider a deeper program-level rebate tied to spend thresholds.

Concessions we're prepared to extend now (conditional on signed MSA/PO):
- One-time onboarding credit (applied to first invoice) for Growth tier customers who commit 12 months.
- Quarterly invoice option (if you opt-in and commit to forecasting cadence).
- Legal will include a data residency clause for EU-hosted keys and logs if required (we'll provide a template).

I've copied Rishi to expedite any discount exceptions and Marissa for enablement planning. If you want, I'll convert the proposal into a mutual action plan and send that to procurement.

Best,
Vanessa

Vanessa / Marissa —

Saw Vanessa's thread with Trillion Bank. Finance is comfortable with the following one-time concession to help close Growth:

- Approve up to 7.5% additional per-token rebate on Growth committed price for a 12-month contract (internal approval code FIN-TRI-726). This is a one-time concession and should be documented in the quote as a promotional adjustment.
- Approve quarterly true-up instead of monthly for Growth if the customer provides a 90-day rolling forecast and agrees to the forecast governance cadence (monthly review with enablement).

Please do not promise anything beyond the 7.5% without a formal credit request. Legal should be included to finalize the SLA/data-residency language.

Vanessa —

Thanks — that all looks reasonable. We will move forward on the Growth tier with the following bullets to be reflected in the final quote/DocuSign:

- Growth: 100M tokens/year at negotiated price (Growth list $0.00055 less 7.5% promotional rebate)
- Quarterly true-up with 90-day rolling forecast and monthly sync between our platform team and Redwood enablement
- Hosted Plus SLA (99.95% per-region availability for EU/US) with the latency SLO for EU clarified as discussed
- Data residency language for EU logs/keys to be appended to SOW

Please send a DocuSign link with the quote and MSA. Procurement will issue a PO after signature. Also include the onboarding credit on the first invoice as discussed.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — procurement@trillionbank.com is on copy to pick up the DocuSign.

Jordan
